# Trade with ACE

> Trade with ACE is a floating desktop discipline coach for day traders and prop firm traders. It sits over your trading platform with a pre-trade checklist, trade counter, risk guardrails, and an AI mentor.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, and download for Windows & Mac.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free and paid plans with feature comparison.
- [Sign up](/register): Create an account to download the app.
- [Log in](/login): Existing user sign-in.
